description:
The image depicts a serene mountainous landscape featuring two cows grazing in the grassy terrain. The cows, both light brown in color, appear to be of the same breed and share a similar size.

**Key Features:**

* One cow stands on a hillside, facing the left side of the image.
* Another cow is partially visible behind the first cow, with its head obscured from view.
* The background of the image showcases a majestic mountainous landscape, characterized by rolling hills and towering peaks
